text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wah, I'm so happy! Thank you, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Um, so... about your birthday present you 
mentioned before... Are you really sure 
you just want Falco's autograph?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course!! An autograph from a future top 
Umadol is super-duper rare! I even wanna 
put it up at my part-time job♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ines-san... thank you! Ehehe. It feels 
like Falco was the one who got a present 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Would it be alright if you waited 
a bit longer for my present?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking about a lot of things, 
and the list of candidates just grew too 
big... I'm still trying to decide.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You wished me a happy birthday and even 
put so much thought into it. Just knowing 
you care makes me so happy! Thank you, 
Suzuka-chan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey. If you're still undecided, 
how about you come up with an autograph 
too, Suzuka-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Sure, I have an autograph, but I'm 
not an Umadol, so...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see... Ah! In that case, how about we 
form a unit together sometime?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Wah~! What a nice idea~~!\nI'm sure it'll 
make a wonderful unit."
